name: Javier (Spain)
description: Red field charged with a crescent chequy of black and yellow above two horizontal stripes chequy of black and yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Javier; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
